title: Our mission
slide_intent: Break a long mission into service, audience and purpose so a reader can see which language answers each question.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can preserve the approved mission while making its component promises easier for contributors to explain.
demonstration: The page sets the mission in red bands against a pale historical image. Three black arrows point to the clauses about what, whom and why. A footnote adds families and the wider community as beneficiaries.
practical_value: Check whether a short description covers the activity, the people served and what participation makes possible.

content_islands.name: Historical background and heading
content_islands.spec: Repeat the historical image at low contrast and place the gray section label and red heading above it.

content_islands.name: Mission clauses
content_islands.spec: Set three black arrow labels in the left rail and align each with its red statement band. Give the extended purpose clause the deepest band.

content_islands.name: Audience footnote
content_islands.spec: Place the note about families and community in a separate white block beneath the labels.
